text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions early, then later bought back Stock B at a higher price. I should avoid treating a realized gain as proof that selling was right; base decisions on expected returns and a consistent plan.","I held through steep declines before selling Stock A at a large loss. My reluctance to admit mistakes can make losses worse, so I should reassess positions objectively and act when the investment case changes.","Frequent trades and decisions based on each stock’s gain or loss can undermine portfolio-level judgment. I should define reasons and limits for trades in advance, and consider cash, risk, and the whole portfolio before acting."]}
